To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) analytical models of rotating components can be combined with vibration measurement techniques to detect and estimate damage in rotating components; 2) the models must be able to predict the response of the component to a wide range of damage modes; 3) the model must be sufficiently accurate and efficient to allow repeated analysis of a large number of cases in a short time; 4) the models should be capable of predicting the response of the system to a range of damage modes and crack sizes;
• The analytical model is capable of predicting the displacement response of a generic engine compressor disk containing one or more fatigue cracks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of analytical modeling techniques to provide accurate information on the damage state of a rotating disk, and to assist in the development of a damage monitoring system.

the use of analytical methods to simulate the damage modes of turbine engine disks and to predict the resulting vibration signatures.
